verdict.rationale: Motion has a public pricing page that names at least one tier ("Business AI … for power users and businesses with complex needs"), lists what tiers include (Gantt charts, time tracking, capacity planning, permissions, dashboards), and states a per-seat allowance (15,000 credits/seat/month). However, no actual per-seat dollar amounts or full tier-by-tier comparison appear in the evidence, so what each tier costs is unproven. Missing for 10: published per-seat prices for each tier, a complete list of tiers with inclusions, clarity on whether a sales conversation is needed, independent corroboration.
